channel.title: Papyri — Free Paperwork Tools
channel.description: Updates from Papyri: free, browser-only receipt, invoice, timesheet, contract, expense, and packing-slip generators. No signup, nothing leaves your browser.

item.title: Packing Slip Generator
item.description: Item and quantity list with ship-to address and order reference, no pricing shown. Free, printable, no signup.

item.title: Expense Report Generator
item.description: Itemized expenses auto-grouped by category with running subtotals and a grand total. Free, printable, no signup.

item.title: Contract Generator
item.description: Toggleable clause system — confidentiality, termination, payment terms, liability, governing law. Assembles live. Free, printable, no signup.

item.title: Timesheet Generator
item.description: Weekly hours by day, auto-totaled, optional hourly pay calculation. Free, printable, no signup.

item.title: Receipt & Invoice Generator
item.description: Retail, Service, Rental, and Freelance Invoice templates with live calculating totals. Free, printable, no signup.
